title: Managed pi-web Long-running automatic-pause policy
description: Verify the managed session Long-running switch is off by default, persists across reloads, bypasses automatic pause when enabled, and restores the configured idle timeout when disabled.

requires.cloudRun: Creates one disposable marked pi-chrome service
requires.managedWorkspace: Use the explicitly marked disposable workspace setup
requires.idlePolicy: The session must expose the backend idle timeout and Long-running control

steps.expected: Automatically pauses after 60 minutes without activity.
Automatically pauses after 60 minutes without activity.
